facts.fact: Tech Review Africa says the free roaming agreements were signed by Senegal's regulator head and his counterparts from Togo and Benin; no signing date is given, so the published date is used.
The free roaming arrangement between Senegal, Togo and Benin took effect on 24 April 2026 in Lomé, with free incoming calls for up to 30 consecutive days.

systems.owner: ARCEP Bénin, ARCEP Togo, ARTP Senegal
